evaluation_notes: Inspected all 33 frames at ../artifacts/frames_v13/f_01.jpg through f_33.jpg. Read critics/SHARED.md and the brief; ../references/CINEMATOGRAPHY.md was unavailable. Camera-movement scoring is provisional: 2.5-second samples cannot establish smoothness, jitter, shutter characteristics or screen tracking between frames.

issues.evidence: At 00:35, 00:40, 00:52.5 and 01:05, enlarged UI rectangles float over the same blurred desk. Slight perspective provides an angle, but no visible monitor edge, foreground occlusion or shared light establishes their physical depth.
issues.suggested_action: Recompose this sequence around Maya's actual monitor plane, retaining a bezel and foreground shoulder; use focused inserts for individual changes and return to the wider reviewing position before acceptance.

issues.evidence: The request beginning 'Research says 20% DACH growth' is visibly soft and darkened, including text inside the yellow focus rectangle; a second quotation and 'One request. Her real model, memo and deck.' compete below it.
issues.suggested_action: Use a sharper source crop with the active request lines in crisp focus, dim only the surrounding UI, and retain one short caption outside the screen.

issues.evidence: At 00:40 the memo's right-hand sentences and FY26 table column run into the crop; at 00:42.5 'Insert' loses its opening letter and 'Accept all' is cut by the right edge.
issues.suggested_action: Frame each insert around a complete visual unit: the full changed memo sentence or the entire Excel diff bar, leaving breathing room on both sides and placing captions below the document.

issues.evidence: The Excel edit, memo edit, slide edit and PowerPoint playback repeatedly use nearly identical laptop-left/shoulder-right geometry, with the same city bokeh and folder arrangement.
issues.suggested_action: Keep the opening shoulder shot, then alternate a tighter screen insert, a lateral hands shot and a reverse reaction while preserving the desk axis and lamp direction.

issues.evidence: Maya's reviewing face is dim and broadly filled; the navy shoulder merges into the dark background, with less facial modelling and edge separation than the 00:30 close-up.
issues.suggested_action: Shape a soft screen-motivated key from frame-left, reduce opposite-side fill and add a restrained cool window rim along her frame-right shoulder.

issues.evidence: David sits centrally against bright windows; both cheeks receive similar soft illumination and the window background remains relatively detailed, producing a conventional corporate portrait.
issues.suggested_action: Use a three-quarter 85mm portrait, negative fill on the near cheek, controlled window highlights and slightly shallower focus; allow lead room toward his glance.

issues.evidence: The sampled Maya shots differ in apparent facial proportions, loose hair and blouse neckline; the 00:30 close-up also shows a prominent hoop earring absent from the shoulder views.
issues.suggested_action: Verify these cuts at playback size against the approved character reference; if the mismatch persists, replace the reaction insert with a matching take and consistent wardrobe.

issues.evidence: The two sampled flagged-slide frames have essentially unchanged geometry, as do the two end-card frames; the samples do not establish motivated movement through these holds.
issues.suggested_action: Verify the full clips before changing them; retain deliberate locked holds, but if the flagged-slide beat feels frozen, introduce one restrained push toward the circled box and settle before the reaction cut.

top_revision: Recompose the product demo as a sequence of physically grounded monitor shots and sharp, carefully framed inserts, replacing the recurring floating UI rectangles over the blurred desk.
